Name: Monster Iframe Reducer
Author: SucyuAn
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Reduces the invincibility frames (i-frames) of monsters after they take damage, making combat feel faster and more responsive.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The mod does not change monster health, damage, or AI—only the duration of post-hit invincibility.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Reduces monster invincibility duration after being hit[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fully configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu
Adjustable multiplier from 0.1 to 1.0
    0.1 = very fast combat
    1.0 = vanilla behavior[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Does not modify damage, HP, or monster AI[/color]
